filters.predicate: name IS NOT NULL AND (name LIKE '%man%' OR name LIKE '%Man%')

join_order.notes: For each t.id in title_set, iterate movie_keyword via movie_keyword__movie_id offsets; check kw_set[mk.keyword_id]. Collect surviving t.ids into a movie_id bitset.
Iterate cc via complete_cast__movie_id offsets; require subject_id == cct1_id AND complete_status_set[status_id]. Keep movie_ids.
Iterate mi_idx via movie_info_idx__movie_id offsets; require info_type_id == it2_id. Capture mi_idx.info varlen for MIN aggregation per surviving movie.

Iterate ci via cast_info__movie_id offsets; require ci.person_role_id IS NOT NULL AND chn_set[ci.person_role_id]. Capture chn.name varlen for MIN. n.id=ci.person_id is no-op (dense PK, FK always valid).

data_structures.aggregation: three running MINs (scalar) using lexicographic comparison on varlen strings

parallelism.notes: Partition title.id range into morsels; each thread maintains local MIN triple for chn.name, mi_idx.info, t.title; merge at end via lex-min reduction.

implementation_notes: Build phase order: scan tiny dims (kt, it2, cct) first to get scalar ids; abort early if any required dim id is missing.
kw_set: scan keyword.keyword varlen once, mark 10 matches into bitset.
chn_set: scan char_name.name varlen with memmem for 'man' and 'Man' (no allocations); mark id in bitset.
Driver loop: walk title.id range, gate on title_set, then for each surviving t.id execute the 4-stage probe early-exiting at first failed semi-join.
For mi_idx and ci value capture: only fetch varlen .off/.dat slices when needed for MIN update (i.e., compare current best against candidate using memcmp-style lex compare without allocating).
Per-thread local MINs reduce contention; combine via three pairwise lex-min comparisons at end.
